Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 83 S. 2010 01 June 2010 ATTY. RENATO ZOSIMO B. EVANGELISTA Crisologo Evangelista & Associates Suites 207 & 209 Criscor Bldg. 1258 Quezon Ave. cor. Scout Reyes St Quezon City Dear Atty Evangelista: This has reference to your earlier letter asking this Department's legal opinion regarding the issuance of Barangay Clearance and Mayor's Permit in favor of your client, Ming Hong Trading Co. Specifically, you requested for legal opinion on the following issues, which we quoted in toto: Is Barangay Permit a pre-requisite for issuance of a Mayor's Permit? 2. Are the po wers of th e m unicipal mayor an d barangay chairman in the issuance of a permit a discretionary or ministerial In reply to your first query, please be informed that this Department had already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 15, series of2007. In the said legal opinion, we opined that no city or municipality may issue any license or permit for any business or activity unless a clearance is first obtained from the barangay where such business or activity is located or conducted. This is commonly called the barangay clearance under Section 152 of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160). We also opined therein that the application for barangay clearance shall be acted upon within 7 working days from the filing thereof and in the event that the clearance is not issued within the said period, the city or municipality may already issue the corresponding mayor's permit or license. Anent your second query, this Department had already an occasion to answer a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 94, series of 2007 where we opined that once all the requirements are met and complied with by the applicant business establishment, the issuance of the applied mayor's permit becomes purely ministerial and not discretionary.

-2- Hereto attached are the photocopies of the aforesaid DILG Opinions for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Ls/17 Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: A . JES B. DOQ E W Dir ctor III
